title.id: Halaman Detail Aplikasi, Tautan Lokapasar Resmi & Spesifikasi Lengkap
title.en: Application Detail Showcase, Official Marketplace Links & Comprehensive System Specs

body.id: Penyempurnaan halaman detail aplikasi mandiri di Store Mituni dengan integrasi tautan lokapasar resmi (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, dll.), spesifikasi persyaratan hardware, galeri tampilan layar, panduan aktivasi, dan tanya jawab konsumen.
body.en: Comprehensive enhancement of application detail pages on Store Mituni featuring official marketplace store links (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, etc.), system compatibility specs, interactive galleries, activation guides, and buyer FAQs.

items.id: Integrasi tautan toko e-commerce resmi (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada, Website) pada bilah pintasan Hero, kartu edisi paket produk, serta seksi khusus Toko Resmi.
items.en: Integration of official e-commerce store links (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada, Website) across the Hero shortcut bar, product edition cards, and a dedicated Official Stores section.

items.id: Penyajian informasi spesifikasi persyaratan sistem dan kompatibilitas perangkat keras (Android 8.0+, mode 100% offline tanpa kuota, tablet kasir, mesin POS all-in-one, dan printer thermal bluetooth).
items.en: Presentation of comprehensive system requirements and hardware compatibility specifications (Android 8.0+, 100% offline operation, cash register tablets, all-in-one POS terminals, and bluetooth thermal printers).

items.id: Penyediaan seksi tanya jawab seputar pembelian dan lisensi (FAQ) untuk menjawab pertanyaan seputar pengiriman kode lisensi via chat marketplace, jaminan tanpa biaya bulanan, dan reset perangkat.
items.en: Provision of a buyer FAQ section addressing marketplace license delivery times, zero hidden monthly subscription fees, and official device reset procedures.

items.id: Penyajian lencana jaminan keaslian lisensi (100% Asli Terdaftar di Server Mituni, Aktivasi Cepat & Mandiri, serta Garansi Reset Resmi).
items.en: Presentation of trust and authenticity guarantee badges highlighting verified server registration, instant self-activation, and authorized device reset coverage.

items.id: Penyediaan galeri cuplikan layar interaktif dengan penampil gambar beresolusi tinggi dan mode pembesar layar penuh.
items.en: Interactive screenshot showcase gallery featuring high-resolution image previews and full-screen zoom capability.

items.id: Penyajian pilihan edisi paket lisensi lengkap dengan harga transparan per marketplace, ketersediaan stok, dan tombol beli langsung.
items.en: Presentation of license package editions with transparent marketplace-specific pricing, live inventory status, and direct purchase buttons.

items.id: Penambahan panduan aktivasi lisensi tiga langkah praktis untuk mempermudah calon pelanggan memahami proses pemasangan hingga pemakaian aplikasi.
items.en: Addition of a practical three-step license activation guide to help prospective customers effortlessly understand the installation and onboarding process.
